## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Financials and Industrials both negative and defensives (JNJ, PG) ABOVE TREND — two independent confirmations for RISK-OFF; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Sector counts: Materials 6/7 positive; Energy 6/8 positive; Consumer Stpl. 8/12 positive; Healthcare 9/15 positive; Consumer Disc. 6/11 positive; Technology 7/19 positive; Utilities 2/6 positive; Communication 2/7 positive; Industrials 4/13 positive; Financials 5/20 positive; Real Estate 1/6 positive.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Materials lead: NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%) ABOVE TREND; Energy strong: SLB (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +28.23%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare showing resilience: UNH (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +9.56%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Financials lag: MS (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND and JPM (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -7.44%) BELOW TREND; Technology lagging overall with internal rotation: AAPL (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -10.46%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMD (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND; GILD (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +9.48%) ABOVE TREND; NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +6.11% | 1M: -0.41%) RECOVERY; SLB (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +28.23%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical + tech + healthcare mix.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: ABT (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -13.77%) BELOW TREND; COF (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -11.94%) BELOW TREND; GE (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -6.52%) BELOW TREND; AVGO (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -6.27%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -10.46%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Financials and select Tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: AMD (1W: +13.93%), GILD (1W: +12.10%), NEM (1W: +8.84%). Watch divergences: INTC (1W: -6.73% | 1M: +23.92%) CORRECTION and multiple large caps with 1W ≠ 1M constitute a MAJOR divergence — tactical, not core confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with net weakness and rotation away from big cap breadth; NVDA (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +2.17%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -10.46%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth: 7/19 positive.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Soft and under pressure with breadth weak; MS (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -7.44%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +2.21%) CORRECTION — Sector breadth: 5/20 positive.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Relatively defensive and one of the more stable pockets; UNH (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +9.56%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +6.18%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -13.77%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth: 9/15 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor defensive/quality cyclicals and select materials/energy exposure (JNJ (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +6.18%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +9.56%) ABOVE TREND; NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to richly valued, under‑trend techs (AAPL, ORCL, AVGO). Style: Value over Growth given RISK-OFF and defensive leadership; monitor the major-cap divergences before adding net beta.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +9.56%) ABOVE TREND; NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: ABT (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -13.77%) BELOW TREND; COF (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -11.94%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Materials (6/7 positive) and Energy (6/8 positive) on commodity/capex flows.  
BEARISH: Financials (5/20 positive) and Technology (7/19 positive) as risk-off positioning persists.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA for hold above weekly support to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; AAPL failing to reclaim its 1M trend is a downside trigger for broader tech weakness; JPM failing to stabilize around recent weekly pivots would signal deeper Financials risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
JNJ (+50): Q4 beat headline—JNJ (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +6.18%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.  
NEM (+50): Gold tailwinds—NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed and already leadership.  
GE (+50): Aerospace backlog bullish—GE (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -6.52%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for confirmation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ABT (-60): Earnings miss—ABT (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -13.77%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and elevated risk.  
COF (-55): Regulatory/credit-card headlines—COF (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -11.94%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and price weak.  
INTC (-55): Weak guidance—INTC (1W: -6.73% | 1M: +23.92%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines vs large 1M gain is divergence; monitor for trend break.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Value-leaning.  
UNH (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +9.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND and NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength.  
Key risk is the MAJOR divergence among mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, INTC) plus negative headlines on ABT/COF — monitor for trend confirmation before re‑risking beta.
